Author: wellm
Name: MasterBaiter
Punchline: Keeps your fishing bait and lures stocked, on its own.
Description:
Reads your GatherBuddy Reborn auto-gather list, works out which fishing bait and lures those fish need, and compares that against your inventory.

It shows what is missing, where to buy it and what it costs. It travels to the vendors on its own with vnavmesh and Lifestream, restocks at gil shops and scrip exchanges, plans a route across several vendors, rides to the Cosmic Exploration planets, and can fill the rest at the market board within a price per item and a total per run that you set.

Lures are counted separately from bait, because they cost many times as much.

Requires GatherBuddy Reborn, vnavmesh and Lifestream.
Changelog:
0.3.1
- Options now has "Export log to desktop" for sending diagnostics to whoever gave you this.
